items.label: UPF 50+ Sun Protection
items.value: Made with advanced UPF 50+ polyester fabric, this fishing hoodie blocks 98% of UVA and UVB rays, protecting your skin from harmful UV damage during outdoor activities

items.label: Breathable & Quick-Drying
items.value: Our moisture-wicking and fast-drying technology ensures sweat evaporates quickly, keeping you cool and dry even in summer hot weather. Enhanced breathability helps release excess heat and moisture, ensuring all-day comfort

items.label: Lightweight & Comfortable
items.value: This ultra-light fishing shirt features flatlock seams and a tagless design to reduce friction. The soft, elastic fabric moves with your body, offering unrestricted comfort and a loose fit for all-day wear

items: Hooded Thumb Hole & Mesh Design – Featuring a hooded thumb hole design and mesh ventilation holes, this SPF hoodie offers excellent protection for the head, neck, and hands while increasing breathability. The thumbholes keep sleeves in place and shield your hands from sun exposure. Stay cool and comfortable during outdoor activities, with added flexibility for movement

items.label: Perfect for Outdoor Activities
items.value: Ideal for fishing, beach outings, hiking, swimming, workouts, running, athletics, hunting, camping, water sports, and more. It’s also perfect for outdoor workers such as construction workers, gardeners, landscapers, lawn care professionals, and those engaged in fieldwork
